// diagnostic E0228

Jet.CallMarkRequired

A call is missing `^` before a named argument its callee's signature changes, or writes a mark that disagrees with the signature.

What

A call is missing `^` before a named argument its callee's signature changes, or writes a mark that disagrees with the signature.

Why

Every call writes `^` before each named argument it changes (`grow(^xs)`), including a forwarded `^` parameter, so writes are visible in diffs and plain text. Method receivers stay plain (`xs.push(4)`), and `^^` on a whole-name take is optional and checked when written.

Fix

Write `^` before the named argument the quoted signature changes, or `^^` (or no mark) for a whole-name take.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.CallMarkRequired: Tests/UI/E0228_take_mark_explains_take.stderr.

Error: Jet.CallMarkRequired: `^^` cannot mark a part of `st`
  --> Tests/UI/E0228_take_mark_explains_take.jet:19:10
    |
 19 |     seal(^^st.buf)
    |          ^^
 Why: `seal: fn(xs: ^^[Int])` takes this input, but a `^^` call mark applies only to a whole named value, not a field or indexed part
 Fix: Remove `^^`, or write `.move()` on the part if you intend to move it out
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.CallMarkRequired

Error: Jet.CallMarkRequired: `n` is a copied type, so `take_n` takes no `^^`
  --> Tests/UI/E0228_take_mark_explains_take.jet:21:12
    |
 21 |     take_n(^^n)
    |            ^^
 Why: `take_n: fn(n: ^^Int)` takes this input by value, which copies `n` instead of moving it, so `n` stays usable after the call
 Fix: Remove the `^^`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.CallMarkRequired
